entities.name: Władysław Taczanowski
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Władysław Taczanowski was a Polish zoologist and collector of natural history who explored the Russian Far East and northern Africa. He specialized mainly in ornithology but also described numerous other taxa including reptiles and arachnids.
